title: 第三章 夜入林府炼气开海第四章 尽吞林府凡俗无敌
content_zh:
白昼转瞬即逝。
黑石镇的白日素来庸碌乏味，市井人声嘈杂，贩夫走卒往来不休，众生皆为一口粮、一寸安身之地奔波劳碌，岁岁年年，循环往复，从未有过半分超脱。
对于寻常凡人而言，日出而作、日落而息，便是一生全部的意义。
但对烬孤宸而言，这一日的凡尘喧嚣，不过是他苦修路上，一段无足轻重的过眼云烟。
整整一个白昼，他未曾踏出茅屋半步。
闭门静坐，不动不摇，始终盘坐于冰冷的青石板之上，持续运转《寂骨锻体诀》。
道源残烬蛰伏掌心，丝丝缕缕寂灭道韵渗透周身。
这片凡界灵气枯竭稀薄，旁人穷尽日夜，也难捕捉半分天地灵机。可在他道源体质的吞噬之力下，哪怕是散落在风雪泥土、草木空气里最微末的灵气碎屑，也被尽数牵引而来，吞纳入体，淬炼筋骨血肉。
一夜一日苦修，他的锻体根基，彻底抵达圆满极致。
皮肉致密如精铁，筋骨坚韧如玄钢，周身杂质尽数剔除，凡人数十年打熬体魄留下的淤堵、暗疾、虚浮，在道源本源的反复洗练下，荡然无存。
此刻的烬孤宸，看似身形依旧清瘦，实则肉身早已脱胎换骨。
举手投足间，暗藏千斤力道，寻常凡俗刀兵、拳脚蛮力，已然难以伤他分毫。
可他并未就此止步。
锻体圆满，只是铺路。
真正踏入修行，脱凡入道的第一道门槛，是炼气。
锻体淬炼皮囊，养肉身蛮力；炼气开辟气海，纳天地灵气，凝修行真力。
一凡一道，云泥之别。
只是这片天地灵气太过贫瘠，仅凭静坐吞吐，速度慢如龟爬。若死守茅屋苦修，即便耗尽年月，也未必能顺利开辟气海，踏入炼气之境。
他需要资源。
黑石镇之内，唯一藏有微薄资源的地方，只有镇东的林府。

林家是黑石镇盘踞数十年的首富之家，良田千亩，囤粮满仓，院中常年栽种寻常药草、珍稀草木。这些在富贵人家眼中微不足道的绿植药材，蕴含的草木精元，对如今急需突破的烬孤宸来说，已是足以助力开海的至宝。
暮色沉沉，夕阳彻底沉入远山，最后一缕余晖消散天际。
夜幕笼罩整座黑石镇，街巷灯火逐一熄灭，家家户户紧闭门窗，陷入沉寂。
寒风再起，卷动地上残雪，夜色寒凉如铁。
烬孤宸缓缓睁开眼眸。
漆黑瞳孔平静无波，没有躁动，没有急切，更无半分少年人行事的鲁莽冲动。
他起身，拍落衣衫上的细碎雪沫。
破烂的粗布麻衣依旧蔽体，身形孑然，立于幽暗茅屋之中，孤冷的身影与沉沉夜色融为一体。
昨日，林府护院仗势欺人，拳脚相加，践踏他的尊严，碾碎他唯一的吃食。
他心中无恨，无怨，无滔天戾气。
世间弱肉强食，本是天理。
昨日他弱，活该受辱。
今日他强，当取所需。
不谓复仇，不谓泄愤，只为修行，只为变强，只为挣脱这凡尘牢笼。
弱者的哀嚎无人听闻，唯有强者的规则，能定自身前路。
content_en:
The day passes quickly.
The daytime in Blackstone Town has always been dull and boring, with noisy people in the market, endless traffic of traders and foot soldiers, and all living beings working hard for a morsel of food and an inch of shelter. Year after year, the cycle repeats, and there is never a moment of detachment.
For ordinary people, working at sunrise and resting at sunset is the entire meaning of life.
But for Jin Guchen, the hustle and bustle of this day's world is just an insignificant passing cloud on his journey of ascetic cultivation.
For a whole day, he never stepped out of the hut.
Sit quietly behind closed doors, not moving, always sitting cross-legged on the cold bluestone, and continue to run the "Silent Bone Body Training Technique".
The remaining embers of the Tao source lay dormant in the palm of the hand, and the wisps of the dying Tao charm penetrated the whole body.
The spiritual energy in this mortal world is exhausted and thin, and it is difficult for others to capture even a fraction of the heaven and earth's inspiration even if they spend their days and nights. But under the devouring power of his Principle Source Physique, even the tiniest fragments of spiritual energy scattered in the wind, snow, soil, vegetation, and air were all pulled in, swallowed into the body, and tempered with muscles, bones, flesh, and blood.
After practicing hard night and day, his physical training foundation has completely reached perfection.
The skin and flesh are as dense as fine iron, the muscles and bones are as tough as black steel, and all impurities are removed from the whole body. The blockage, hidden diseases, and emptiness left by ordinary people's body after decades of hard work have disappeared under the repeated refinement of the source of Tao.
At this moment, Jin Guchen seems to be still thin, but in fact, his physical body has been completely reborn.
There is a huge amount of strength hidden in every move of his hands and feet. Ordinary weapons, fists and feet with brute force can hardly hurt him at all.
But he didn't stop there.
The perfect exercise is just paving the way.
The first threshold to truly enter the realm of spiritual practice, to escape from the ordinary world and enter the Tao, is to practice Qi.
Physical exercise tempers the skin and cultivates the physical strength; refining the qi opens up the sea of ​​​​qi, absorbs the spiritual energy of heaven and earth, and condenses the true power of cultivation.
One thing is the same, the other is cloud and mud.
It's just that the spiritual energy of this world is too poor, and just sitting quietly and breathing is as slow as a turtle crawling. If you stick to the hut and practice hard, you may not be able to successfully open up the sea of ​​qi and step into the realm of qi refining even if you spend years and years.
He needs resources.
Within Blackstone Town, the only place with meager resources is the Lin Mansion in the east of the town.
The Lin family has been the richest family in Blackstone Town for decades. It has thousands of acres of fertile land and warehouses full of grain. Common herbs and rare plants are planted in the courtyard all year round. These green medicinal herbs, which are insignificant in the eyes of wealthy people, contain the essence of plants and trees. For Jin Guchen, who is in urgent need of a breakthrough, they are already a treasure that can help open the sea.
The dusk fell, the setting sun completely sank into the distant mountains, and the last ray of afterglow dissipated in the sky.
Night fell over the entire Blackstone Town, the lights in the streets and alleys were extinguished one by one, and every household closed its doors and windows, falling into silence.
The cold wind started again, rolling up the remaining snow on the ground, and the night was as cold as iron.
Jin Guchen slowly opened his eyes.
The dark pupils were calm and calm, with no restlessness, no eagerness, and no trace of the reckless impulsiveness of young people.
He stood up and brushed off the fine snow foam on his clothes.
The tattered coarse linen clothes still cover the body, and the figure is lonely, standing in the dark thatched hut, the lonely figure blending into the dark night.
Yesterday, the guards at the Lin Mansion used their power to bully him, using their fists and kicks to trample on his dignity and crush his only source of food.
There is no hatred, no resentment, no overwhelming anger in his heart.
It is natural law in this world for the weak to eat the strong.
He was weak yesterday and deserved to be humiliated.
Today he is strong and should take what he needs.
It's not about revenge, it's not about venting anger, it's just for practice, it's just for getting stronger, it's just for breaking free from this mortal prison.
The cry of the weak is unheard, and only the rules of the strong can determine their own path forward.
